svg.text: t20-exact-forecast: how the task is built, packaged, run and evidenced
Six stages, left to right. Blue is what the agent sees; red is what only the generator and the verifier hold.
two containers; only two artifacts cross
everything a reviewer reads is generated from the records
three leagues against the real targets;
three Design constants tuned to them
the true p for every fixture
8 graded seeds; 8 more for the bar
total regret at most 1.10 x reference
one per world: the exact answers
fitted from the reloaded public files
engine with public constants, visible world,
public inputs only, network for the model API;
runs the submission as user runner, /tests unreadable;
8 worlds x 720 s, beside a pristine engine
pooled rule on all 8 and on the held-out 7;
two gates, the linter, every pilot;
the job records and the logs
oracle install, or a tuning loop
